summary: Frontend E2E testing of Periodización Fases 2-5 (Material FAB, breadcrumb, search/filters, autosave/undo, history, duplicate meso, comparator) on Super Admin plan 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)' (4 macros/12 mesos/47 micros). Most features PASS. A few blockers found on duplicate-meso and edit-cell selectors, plus one missing testid.

ui_bugs.issue: No element matches [data-testid^='table-cell-vol-'] on the Tabla view. Screenshot confirms Vol%/Int% columns render as plain text (all zeros), so autosave/undo edit flow could NOT be triggered from Vol column. The `field` value used in table-cell-${field} does not appear to be 'vol' (may be 'volumen' / 'volume_percent' / etc.). Please verify the actual data-testid and align with review-request contract ('table-cell-vol-*' / 'table-input-vol-*').

Duplicate-meso button [data-testid='duplicate-meso-0-0'] count=0 in Estructura view. Macros may need to be expanded first; the macrocycle-0 collapsible header does not auto-expand mesos. Expected: duplicate button visible on each meso row per the spec.

No element with [data-testid='view-graphic'] (view-graphic timeout). Other view tabs (view-structure/table/tree/kanban/calendar/dashboard) work. Either 'graphic' view is named differently (e.g. view-graph / view-chart) or the testid is missing.

history-list count=0 after opening 'Historial'. Since no edit could be made (see Vol cell bug), history is empty — cannot confirm autosave writes entries end-to-end from UI. Endpoint verified by main agent via curl.
Console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility'. Add a <DialogTitle> (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) inside history-dialog and comparator-dialog.
React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <select>' inside filter-phase options (caused by dev instrumentation wrapper). Harmless but noisy in dev logs.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise flow from UI because table-cell-vol-* selectors don't exist. Please confirm and update selectors, then re-test.
Duplicate button not exposed on default Estructura render. Need auto-expand or ensure duplicate-meso-{macroIdx}-{mesoIdx} testid present regardless of expansion state.

test_results_passed.fab: PASS - fab-main-btn visible; click reveals fab-add-macro + fab-add-meso
test_results_passed.comparator: PASS - compare-btn opens dialog, compare-plan-select shows 3 options; selecting another plan renders both compare-col-0 and compare-col-1
test_results_passed.regression_views: PASS for view-structure, view-calendar, view-dashboard, view-tree, view-kanban, view-table. FAIL for view-graphic (testid not found)

action_items: Verify actual data-testid used for editable Vol/Int/Carga table cells (spec says 'table-cell-vol-*' / 'table-input-vol-*'). Fix mismatch so autosave+undo flow is testable and matches contract.
Ensure duplicate-meso-{i}-{j} button is present/visible on Estructura view without requiring manual macro expansion OR auto-expand first macro on view mount.
Add data-testid='view-graphic' to the Gráfico tab (or align spec).
Add <DialogTitle> to history dialog & comparator dialog to fix Radix a11y warning.
Re-run autosave/undo/history end-to-end after selector fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: PeriodizationComplete.js is very large (>3500 lines). Consider splitting FAB, breadcrumb+filters bar, history dialog and comparator into dedicated sub-components under /components/periodization/.
select> options are wrapped by dev instrumentation causing hydration warning; verify dev-only impact, ok for prod.
History endpoint integration works (curl verified by main agent); UI empty state ok, but consider showing 'Sin cambios registrados aún' when list is empty.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)' (47 micros)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation path: Login -> click 'Planes' in top nav (opens sidebar) -> click a plan name in the sidebar (this SETS active plan, does NOT navigate). Then click top nav 'Datos' -> click sub-tab 'Periodización' -> click sub-tab 'Estructura'. This mounts <PeriodizationComplete>. There is NO top nav item literally called 'Periodización' at the very top level. Breadcrumb, FAB, filters, comparator all present and functional. Blockers: (1) Vol cell testid mismatch prevents autosave/undo test; (2) duplicate-meso button count=0 on default Estructura render. Fase 1 tree/kanban/table filtering all confirmed working with the new `filters` prop.
rca_of_the_issue: Selector contract mismatch: review-request lists table-cell-vol-* and duplicate-meso-{i}-{j}, but on the live UI Vol cells render as plain <span> or use a different `field` string, and duplicate-meso is only rendered inside a collapsed macro. Both are testability/contract issues, not runtime bugs (comparator, filters, FAB, breadcrumb, view navigation all functional).
